title: Report discovery failures separately from MCP connection success
answers: Why does an MCP server say Connected but show no tools?
How should Desktop handle failed tool discovery after adding a server?
Should no-server and no-connection discovery results show warnings?
body:
Symptom: An added or connected MCP server shows no tools and gives no explanation when tool listing fails.
Root cause: products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useGatewayServers.ts:useGatewayServers and products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks/useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:useRegisterGatewayServer previously discarded discovery rejections and successful results skipped as no-server.
Fix pattern: Handle both rejected discovery and skipped === "no-server" with a recovery warning, while preserving the successful connection or registration outcome.
Constraints: Applies to discovery after connecting or registering. Keep "no-connection" quiet because the server's status tag already explains pending OAuth or reauthentication; a successful listing with zero tools is not itself one of these failure conditions.
applies: Desktop MCP gateway tool discovery after connection or custom-server registration.
